title: 航空複材自動鋪帶
summary: 以自動鋪帶的平面教學路徑，追蹤材料方向、覆蓋、重疊、厚度與固化證據；路徑幾何不等於可用製程。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use flat educational automated-tape-laying paths to track orientation, coverage, overlap, thickness and cure evidence; path geometry is not a qualified process. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 鋪帶方向與剛性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Tape orientation and stiffness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 鋪帶方向與剛性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Tape orientation and stiffness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
steps.instructionEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空複材自動鋪帶實際性能或製程：Ef=230 GPa，Em=3 GPa，Vf=0.60。式 E1=VfEf+(1−Vf)Em，基準結果 139.2 GPa。適用條件：理想單向、完全黏結且無孔隙，非完整航空鋪層剛性。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace automated tape laying: Ef=230 GPa, Em=3 GPa and fibre volume fraction Vf=0.60. Formula E1=VfEf+(1−Vf)Em gives 139.2 GPa. Conditions: Ideal unidirectional, perfectly bonded and void-free material; not a complete aircraft laminate stiffness.
steps.failure: 把E1用在所有方向會高估橫向與剪切剛性。
steps.failureEn: Using E1 in every direction overestimates transverse and shear stiffness.
steps.check: 比較沿纖維與橫向虛擬拉伸曲線，將鋪層角度和試片方向寫入檔名。
steps.checkEn: Compare longitudinal and transverse virtual tensile curves and encode ply angle and coupon orientation in filenames.

knowledge.title: 鋪帶方向與剛性
knowledge.text: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
knowledge.textEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把Vf改成0.55；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 139.2 改為 127.85 GPa。在算式區重算並記下對「鋪帶方向與剛性」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only Vf to 0.55, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 139.2 to 127.85 GPa. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Tape orientation and stiffness, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
複材的彈性模數在所有方向都相同。
optionsEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Composite elastic modulus is identical in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。 比較沿纖維與橫向虛擬拉伸曲線，將鋪層角度和試片方向寫入檔名。
quiz.explanationEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model. Compare longitudinal and transverse virtual tensile curves and encode ply angle and coupon orientation in filenames.

steps.title: 寬帶覆蓋與重疊：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wide-tape coverage and overlap: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 寬帶覆蓋與重疊 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wide-tape coverage and overlap and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 有效覆蓋寬度是材料寬度扣除重疊量；以面積計算時須分辨路徑長、裁切與轉彎損耗。
steps.instructionEn: Effective coverage width is tape width minus overlap; area estimates must distinguish path length, trimming and turn losses.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空複材自動鋪帶實際性能或製程：帶寬w=150 mm，重疊o=5 mm，直線長L=2 m。式 A=(w−o)L，基準結果 0.29 m²。適用條件：平面直線單道幾何示範，不是機器速度、壓力或鋪放工藝。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace automated tape laying: Tape width w=150 mm, overlap o=5 mm and straight length L=2 m. Formula A=(w−o)L gives 0.29 m². Conditions: Flat straight-pass geometry, not machine speed, compaction pressure or a production recipe.
steps.failure: 不同方向的gap與overlap不會互相抵消力學影響。
steps.failureEn: Gaps and overlaps in different directions do not cancel their mechanical effects.
steps.check: 在原創平面路徑圖標出gap與overlap，分別計面積而非只看平均厚度。
steps.checkEn: Mark gaps and overlaps on an original path map and measure each area rather than only average thickness.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace automated tape laying: Tape width w=150 mm, overlap o=5 mm and straight length L=2 m. Formula A=(w−o)L gives 0.29 m². Conditions: Flat straight-pass geometry, not machine speed, compaction pressure or a production recipe.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把o改成10 mm；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 0.29 改為 0.28 m²。在算式區重算並記下對「寬帶覆蓋與重疊」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only o to 10 mm, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 0.29 to 0.28 m². Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Wide-tape coverage and overlap, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 依照本單元基準算式，計算結果與單位為何？
quiz.questionEn: What result and unit follow from the baseline expression?
options: 290 m²
optionsEn: 290 m²
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非航空複材自動鋪帶實際性能或製程：帶寬w=150 mm，重疊o=5 mm，直線長L=2 m。式 A=(w−o)L，基準結果 0.29 m²。適用條件：平面直線單道幾何示範，不是機器速度、壓力或鋪放工藝。 在原創平面路徑圖標出gap與overlap，分別計面積而非只看平均厚度。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace automated tape laying: Tape width w=150 mm, overlap o=5 mm and straight length L=2 m. Formula A=(w−o)L gives 0.29 m². Conditions: Flat straight-pass geometry, not machine speed, compaction pressure or a production recipe. Mark gaps and overlaps on an original path map and measure each area rather than only average thickness.
